claims.paraphrase: Page title.
Page tagline.
Three routing bullets to the diagnostic pages.
Section heading.
Progress is saved after each step to a local file outside the site folder; re-run to resume.
Command: re-run create-cairn-site with --dir.
Nothing repeats: an existing App, pushed repository, or connected domain is not redone.
The tables list each pause point with its command.
Section heading.
A long step may print a local web address and ask you to leave it running.
The local address is served only for that run to your machine and carries no secret.
The page shows live progress during a wait.
It is safe to open, ignore, or close; the page ends when the step ends.
Section heading.
Table header for GitHub recovery.
After scaffolding and before the App, re-running starts the GitHub steps fresh.
App created but install unfinished: re-run resumes at install; App and credentials are safe.
Waiting on an organization owner: re-run once they approve.
App installed but the push was interrupted: re-run resumes safely with nothing lost.
Installation does not cover the repository: add it under Only select repositories and re-run.
Section heading.
Table header for Cloudflare recovery.
Repository pushed but deploy unfinished or declined: re-run continues or names the fix.
Site deployed but sign-in unfinished: re-run repeats the key move and sign-in link safely.
Pointers back to create your site and getting back in.
Section heading.
Table header for domain recovery.
Declined domain: the site keeps working and re-running asks again.
Zone exists but nothing further: re-run rechecks the token and reopens the token page if needed.
Waiting for the nameserver switch is normal and takes minutes to 48 hours.
Delegated to another Cloudflare account: whoever controls it must release the domain.
Delegated but not answering: the record or certificate is still propagating.
Account not on Workers Paid: email onboarding stops until it is turned on.
A decline of email sign-in is a saved answer that is re-offered on re-run.
The decline is described as declining a Workers Paid prompt.
Onboarding still propagating needs a few more minutes.
Pointer to the fuller domain and mail explanation.
Section heading.
Table header for Workers Builds recovery.
Declined Workers Builds: nothing is wrong; re-run with --connect to connect.
Cloudflare GitHub App unauthorized: authorize in the dashboard then re-run with --connect.
Repository not in the App watched list: add it at GitHub installations then re-run.
Config commit sign-in or first build unfinished: re-run with --connect resumes.
A failed build prints the log tail and a dashboard link; fix it then re-run with --connect.
Section heading.
For an expired link or a new day, run the sign-in command.
Command with --dir and --sign-in.
The link is written to the database and opened with no email, with or without a domain or Builds.
The link works ten minutes and the session it opens lasts 30 days.
Add --owner-email to sign in as a changed address.
Section heading.
--start-over sets progress aside and starts fresh in the same directory.
It refuses when real connected resources exist and names what to remove first.
